tools.name: payment_options
tools.description: FREE. Prices, the plain-USDC-transfer pass (0.50 / 3 / 8 USDC on Base for 24 h / 30 days + Team Kit / 90 days + Team Kit), the x402 per-call alternative, the self-hosted Team Kit, and the status of the pass you are using (if any).
